Example Corp. reported quarterly revenue growth of 6.5% to $1.35 billion.
Net income increased to $175 million following stronger subscription sales.
Operating expenses rose by 11%, reducing operating margin by 1.8 percentage points.
The consumer products segment experienced a 9% decline in customer orders.
The company did not reduce its FY2025 revenue guidance.
EPS increased to $1.28, although higher financing costs limited profit growth.
Operating cash flow was positive at $220 million.
Net debt remained at $480 million at the end of the reporting period.
The board reviewed the quarterly financial statements at its scheduled meeting.
Management expects stable demand in Europe but weaker demand in North America.
The company has not announced a change to its dividend policy.
A new service contract may improve revenue, but its timing remains uncertain.
